evidence.note: HashPassword now derives password hashes with argon2.IDKey rather than bcrypt.

model_excerpt.quote: An attacker who obtains the users table cracks password hashes offline. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt at cost 12 in internal/auth/password.go, which keeps offline cracking expensive.

relevance.justification: The changed implementation directly contradicts the model's concrete claim that password hashing uses bcrypt at cost 12.

findings.suggested_fix: Replace the bcrypt cost-12 assertion with the Argon2id algorithm and parameters currently used in internal/auth/password.go.

report.summary: One action-required stale assertion found: the model claims bcrypt at cost 12, but password hashing now uses Argon2id.
